ownerReference.scope: Reference direction only; no raster embedded or traced.

fontHandling.reason: O01L logo masters use custom outlined paths; tagline remains separate text per approved source contract.

assetValidation.visualDesignApproval: NOT VERIFIED by this machine check; D03b/D03c remain separate gates

rasterOpenGapInspection.method: Pinned O37A renderSvg alpha scan at the symbol midline from both canvas edges; each side must contain transparent raster columns before first visible ink.

sourceEvidence.gapFormula: hypot(upperEndpointX - lowerEndpointX, upperEndpointY - lowerEndpointY) - (upperStrokeWidth + lowerStrokeWidth) / 2, then multiply by logicalSizePx / 256
sourceEvidence.limitation: Reproducible vector-endpoint and stroke-cap measurement; no raster export, device rendering, or runtime use is claimed.

codespaceValidation.selectionValidationOrder: Codespace selectors ran and passed with the candidate/unselected manifest before standing D03b selection metadata was applied.
codespaceValidation.runnerScratch: Temporary cache/log/lock paths relocated in-memory to existing ignored Codespace package directory; shared Codespace lock acquired read-only; selector/test commands unchanged.

d03bSelectionEvidence.criterion: The source-derived Connected O output set passed all A.4.1 exporter checks and both required current-main Codespace selectors; standing owner rule selects it without further owner choice.

assetValidationNote: The A.4.1 checker passed the candidate/unselected manifest state. After PASS, only D03b approval/selection metadata changed; source, transform, output bytes, and per-asset hashes were unchanged.

manifestHashEvidence.note: Git committed blob is the canonical SHA-256 source; CRLF worktree bytes are normalized by core.autocrlf and are not a manifest content change.
